title: Canonical simultaneous point-fibre tensor normalization
statement: Fix $D$, a prime $\ell\ne D.p$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a simultaneous point-fibre tensor system $S$. Define $\operatorname{PointFibreDerivedTensorCanonical}(S)$ as the record of: its finite source constraints and K-flat model normalization at every level; its integral Roos normalization; all finite quotient and integral scalar squares; its coefficient-carrier lift; derived fraction-field tensor data with counit equal to the exact-functor factorization map; rational tensor and unit normalizations; derived field-extension tensor data with that same counit normalization and rational scalar squares; and tensor data at every common finite field with exact counit, common-stage tensor normalization and unit at the base field. This is normalization data, not a claim that any $S$ or record exists. The constituent notions are [def-sf-point-fibre-tensor-system] [def-sf-point-finite-source-constraints] [def-sf-point-fibre-tensor-finite-models] [def-sf-point-fibre-tensor-models] [def-sf-point-fibre-tensor-reduction] [def-sf-point-integral-scalar-square] [def-sf-point-fibre-tensor-rational-compatibility] [def-sf-point-fibre-tensor-common-stage].
